name: STAR Assurance — TT to TDB implementation cross-audit
summary: Cross-audit of TDB - TT implementations (ERFA, astropy, skyfield, SPICE, star_tdb, a paper model of USNO C179 eq. 2.6) validated on the published low-precision formula; per-century divergence envelopes and model-family separation 1900-2100.
reference: Explanatory Supplement to the Astronomical Almanac low-precision TDB-TT formula; USNO Circular 179 (Kaplan 2005) eq. 2.6; SOFA/ERFA dtdb (Fairhead & Bretagnon 1990)
reference_observed: all 6 implementations within 50 us of the published formula (max 34.8 us ERFA); paper model of C179 eq. 2.6 equals skyfield to 5e-12 s; synthetic drivers: 49 us valid, 51 us excluded, 10 us post-2000 offset measured exactly

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: seconds (TDB - TT), JD on the TT scale
review.G-06: published formulas cited in source; drivers use documented APIs only (skyfield two-part times)
review.G-08: subprocess only for the audited implementation; epochs via stdin; runner names prefixed
review.G-13: failed run raises with stderr tail; refusing or out-of-tolerance implementations excluded from comparisons
